data.name: Drone Soccer
data.detailed_description:
Drone Soccer is the premiere simulation of the world’s fastest-growing aerial sport. For the uninitiated, the real-world sport is a fast-paced blend of traditional soccer strategy and aggressive, full-contact drone piloting. We've translated that exact experience into the digital arena.

Step into high-speed, full-contact aerial competition where precision flying and teamwork decide every match. Whether you're threading a perfect scoring run as the Striker or slamming opponents out of the sky as a Defender, every second is pure adrenaline.

What is Drone Soccer?

  • The Drones: You aren't flying fragile camera drones. Every quadcopter is encased in a durable, spherical cage. This means you can—and will—smash into walls, the floor, and other players at full speed without dropping out of the sky.

  • The Arena: Matches take place inside a giant netted cage. Suspended in the air at either end of the arena are two large, circular goal hoops.

  • The Rules: Two teams of five face off simultaneously. However, out of the five drones on a team, only one is designated as the Striker.

  • The Objective: The Striker is the only player capable of scoring points by flying through the opposing team's goal hoop. The other four players act as Defenders. Their job is to act as aerial battering rams—blocking the enemy Striker from scoring, protecting their own goal, and smashing a clear flight path for their Striker to attack.

    5v5 Online Multiplayer

    Dive into fast-paced 5v5 matchups that demand sharp reflexes and solid teamwork. With a fully lobby-based system, you dictate how and who you play. Spin up a private, friends-only lobby to practice strategies with your squad, or browse public lobbies to join teams from across the globe.

    Realistic Flight Physics

    This isn’t arcade flying. Experience authentic drone handling modeled after real drone soccer ball flight. Fine-tune your controls with fully customizable rate profiles to match your flying style—whether you're a precision pilot or an aggressive brawler.

    Practice Modes

    New to flying drones or looking to sharpen your edge? Jump into dedicated practice modes to refine your mechanics, experiment with settings, and master advanced maneuvers before heading into competitive play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500, AMD Ryzen 5 1400, or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (2GB) or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
